description: Import one image or song up to 32 MiB: an attached file (file), or a public https link (url, for Claude and hosts with no attachments). logo: true marks the brand’s logo. Returns an asset_staging_key for create_video’s asset_staging_keys (or music_staging_key for a song), good for seven days. Not for footage (edit_video).

file.description: A file attached in ChatGPT. Hosts that cannot attach files send url instead.

logo.description: true when the image is the brand's logo: the video uses it as the brand's mark.

url.description: A public https link to the image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) or song (MP3, WAV, M4A), up to 32 MiB: the file itself, not a page that shows it.

name: import_asset

outputSchema.description: Clypmint import_asset result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Import a shared asset
